The '''Republic command center''' was the main military command room for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma's]] [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|attack]] on Coruscant on [[3996 BBY]] it was briefly occupied by the invaders, although it was retaken by a group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].
